title: Breadboard Tie Point Explorer
description: Click any hole on a half-size breadboard and every hole electrically tied to it lights up.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Students and mentors on their first hardware night

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a labeled breadboard diagram, the learner identifies which holes are electrically connected to a clicked hole.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click a hole to highlight its connected group; toggle to light all four rails at once
pedagogical.assessment: Point at a hole and ask which other holes share its connection before clicking.
